item.title: More than 30 SoCal museums offering free admission today for annual art day
item.description: Nearly 30 museums in Southern California will offer free entry Sunday during this year's Free-for-All, which celebrates free arts and culture in the region.

item.title: North Carolina man shot, killed by Secret Service and local deputy outside of Mar-a-Lago
item.description: The man was identified as 21-year-old Austin Tucker Martin from Moore County, North Carolina.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel, 'El Mencho,' during operation
item.description: Videos show plumes of smoke over the city of Puerto Vallarta and travelers sprinting through the airport of the state's capital in panic.

item.title: DHS suspends Global Entry as partial government shutdown drags on; PreCheck still operational
item.description: DHS said Sunday that the Global Entry program would be shut down as long as the partial government shutdown continues. It comes after the department said it planned to shut down TSA PreCheck as well, but DHS later canceled the PreCheck closure.

item.title: Woman using mobility scooter killed in South LA hit-and-run
item.description: Police said the woman was crossing Slauson Avenue when the driver hit her and sped off. LAPD is looking for a mid-2000s black Chevy Tahoe or Suburban with front-end damage.

item.title: LA County patrol vehicle struck by gunfire in Rolling Hills Estates, sheriff's department says
item.description: After hearing a loud pop, the deputy got out to inspect the vehicle, finding a single bullet hole on the passenger side of the trunk hatch.

item.title: Victim advocate helps other women and girls after spending teen years in Figueroa Corridor
item.description: Police say some of the women you see wearing revealing outfits along "the Blade" are not adults at all. ABC7 spoke to a human trafficking survivor who is now helping other women and young girls get out.

item.title: Warm and sunny week on tap for SoCal before warmup brings summer-like temps
item.description: Southern California will continue to see mild and sunny conditions, and by the end of this week, many areas will see summer-like temperatures.

item.title: FBI director joins US men's hockey team in rowdy locker room celebration of Olympic gold medal
item.description: Video is going viral of FBI Director Kash Patel celebrating with the U.S. men's hockey team following their gold medal victory. He's seen drinking beer from a bottle and spraying the rest around the locker room.

item.title: Preliminary 3.5-magnitude earthquake rattles Rancho Palos Verdes area, USGS says
item.description: Did you feel it? A preliminary 3.5-magnitude earthquake rattled the Los Angeles County coastline on Sunday night, according to the U.S. Geological Survey.
